content: Fortunately, we believe that the introduction of unsupervised generative language models presents a way in which to tackle this particular shortcoming of peer-to-peer markets. In 2014, Ian Goodfellow et. al proposed the general adversarial network (GAN) [5]. The group showcased how this generative model could learn to artificially replicate data patterns to an unprecedented realistic degree [5]. Since then, these models have shown tremendous potential in their ability to generate photo-realistic images and coherent text samples [5].
